name: Hans-Peter Richter
bio:
Hans-Peter's analytical mind was honed early, growing up amidst the challenging climbs of the Austrian Alps. He initially pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, fascinated by the intricacies of vehicle dynamics. However, the roar of engines at a local hillclimb event sparked a passion for motorsport. He transitioned to a motorsport engineering program, excelling in race strategy simulations. His early career saw him rise through the ranks of smaller racing teams, mastering the art of optimizing race plans on limited budgets. 

Hans-Peter's approach is meticulously data-driven, but he also values intuition and understanding the human element within the team. He believes in empowering team members to contribute their unique insights, fostering a collaborative environment where innovative solutions can emerge. His ability to quickly adapt strategies based on real-time data and his commitment to team cohesion make him a valuable asset to Opala Legends. Hans-Peter is known for his ability to see the big picture while meticulously tracking the details, giving Opala Legends a competitive edge.

physical.description: A man of medium build, he often has a focused, intense look about him.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, even in team meetings.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on the table when deep in thought.
Drinks chamomile tea religiously before every race.
